title: ZoneReading
description: One measurement for one zone of one camera, produced by the vision pipeline about once per second. The agent reads only this; it never looks at pixels directly.

ts.description: UTC time of the frame, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-12T09:30:01Z

zone_id.description: Unique within the camera, e.g. FOB2-STAIRS-DOWN

zone_type.description: Used by the agent to pick the right action

area_m2.description: Real floor area of the zone after calibration

turbulence.description: 0 = everyone moving smoothly the same way, 1 = chaotic pushing in all directions

flow_speed_mps.description: Median walking speed in the zone, metres per second

confidence.description: How much the pipeline trusts this reading

quality_flags.description: Why confidence is low. Empty list when everything is fine

evidence_frame.description: Optional. Path or S3 key of the annotated frame, faces blurred
